articles.title: China leverages short-video ecosystem, lower costs to carve out lead in AI video
articles.summary: Chinese AI companies are gaining a significant edge in video generation by harnessing extensive short-video ecosystems, more flexible copyright regulations, and competitive pricing, positioning themselves as formidable challengers to US tech giants in a realm where traditional computing power is not the sole determinant of success. This breakthrough not only reshapes the competitive landscape of AI video but also signals a shift in innovation dynamics between the US and China.
